SUBJECT: RESOLUTION NO. SA 23-01 - FACSIMILE SIGNATURES

Background:

Government Code §5501 provides that any authorized officer may, after filing with the
Secretary of State his manual signature certified by him under oath, execute or cause to
be executed, certain documents including any instrument of payment, with a facsimile
signature in lieu of a manual signature. Following the filing of the facsimile signature with
the Secretary of State, banks may be directed to honor all checks, drafts, and warrants
when bearing those signatures and facsimile signatures.

This resolution authorizes banks to honor checks, drafts and warrants bearing the manual
or facsimile signatures of Chair Valencia plus the manual or facsimile signature of Jana
Stuard, Finance Officer.

Fiscal Impact: N/A

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Plan 2021 Implementation: N/A

Recommended Action:

Staff recommends the Board of Directors adopt Resolution No. SA 23-01, A
RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING CERTAIN BANKS TO
HONOR ALL CHECKS, DRAFTS, AND WARRANTS WHEN BEARING CERTAIN
SIGNATURES AND FACSIMILE SIGNATURES OF AGENCY OFFICIALS AND
RESCINDING ALL CONFLICTING RESOLUTIONS.

Attachment:

Resolution No. SA 23-01
   RESOLUTION NO. SA 23-01

  A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK
  REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING
  CERTAIN BANKS TO HONOR ALL CHECKS, DRAFTS, AND
  WARRANTS WHEN BEARING CERTAIN SIGNATURES AND
  FACSIMILE SIGNATURES OF AGENCY OFFICIALS AND RESCINDING
  ALL CONFLICTING RESOLUTIONS

  WHEREAS, the Agency has certain Banks as depositories of Agency Funds; and

  WHEREAS, the Agency Board determines that it is necessary for the efficient
administration of the fiscal affairs of the Agency that this Resolution be passed and
adopted.

  NOW, THEREFORE, THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HEREBY DETERMINES, FINDS, AND RESOLVES AS
FOLLOWS:

  Section 1. Each depository of the Successor Agency to the Norwalk
Redevelopment Agency of the City of Norwalk, be and it is hereby requested, authorized
and directed to honor all checks, drafts, warrants or other orders for the payment of money
drawn in the name of the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency of
the City of Norwalk on all of its accounts when bearing or purporting to bear the manual
or facsimile signature of Chair Ana Valencia plus the manual or facsimile signature of
Jana Stuard, Finance Officer.

  Section 2. Said banks, including their correspondent banks, shall be entitled to
honor and to charge the Agency for all such checks, warrants, drafts, or other orders for
the payment of money, regardless of by whom or by what means the actual or purported
facsimile signature or signatures thereon may have been affixed thereto, if such facsimile
signature or signatures resemble the facsimile specimens filed with said bank by the
Secretary of the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency of the City of
Norwalk.

  Section 3. All previous Resolutions authorizing the honoring of signatures and
facsimile signatures of Agency officials other than those set forth in this Resolution are
hereby rescinded.

  APPROVED AND ADOPTED on this 17th day of January 2023.

  ANA VALENCIA
  CHAIR

SUBJECT: RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE FOR THE FISCAL
  PERIOD COMMENCING JULY 1, 2023 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2024

Background:

Pursuant to Section 34177 of the Health and Safety Code (HSC), the Successor Agency
must prepare a Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule annually, listing the anticipated
payments for enforceable obligations to be made from July 1 through the following June
30.

Attached is the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency (Successor
Agency) Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (ROPS 23-24) for the fiscal year
ending June 30, 2024. Resolution No. OB 23-01 approving ROPS 23-24, containing this
information will be presented before the Los Angeles County Fourth Supervisorial District
Consolidated Oversight Board (Oversight Board) on January 25, 2023.

The Oversight Board must approve all ROPS. Furthermore, each Oversight Board-
approved ROPS must be submitted to the Department of Finance (DOF) for review.

The preparation and submittal of ROPS 23-24 are for allowing the Successor Agency to
pay its enforceable obligations for the period from July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024. HSC
Section 34177 requires the Successor Agency to submit an Oversight Board-approved
ROPS 23-24 to the DOF and to the County Auditor-Controller no later than February 1,
2023.

The DOF may eliminate or modify any item on the ROPS before approving the ROPS.
The DOF must make its determination regarding the enforceable obligations and the
amount and funding source for each enforceable obligation listed on ROPS 23-24 no later
than April 15, 2023. Within five business days of the DOF’s determination, the Successor
Agency may request to “meet and confer” with the DOF on disputed items. The DOF will
issue its final determination after the meet and confer.
 Successor Agency  January 17, 2023
ROPS 23-24  Page No. 2

The County Auditor-Controller is required to make Redevelopment Property Tax Trust
Fund (RPTTF) disbursements to the Successor Agency pursuant to the DOF-approved
ROPS 23-24 on June 1, 2023 (to cover enforceable obligation payments from July 1,
2023 through December 31, 2023) and January 2, 2024 (to cover enforceable obligation
payments from January 1, 2024 through June 30, 2024).

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Plan 2021 Implementation: N/A

Recommended Action:

Staff recommends the Agency receive and file the Recognized Obligation Payment
Schedule for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2024.

A RESOLUTION OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOURTH SUPERVISORIAL
DISTRICT CONSOLIDATED OVERSIGHT BOARD APPROVING A RECOGNIZED
OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY OF THE
NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY FOR THE FISCAL PERIOD COMMENCING
FROM JULY 1, 2023 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2024 AND TAKING RELATED ACTIONS

WHEREAS, pursuant to ABx 1 26, enacted in June 2011, and as subsequently amended,
including by AB 1484, SB 341, and SB 107 ("Dissolution Act"), the Redevelopment
Agency to the City of Norwalk was dissolved as of February 1, 2012, and the City of
Norwalk elected to serve as the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment
Agency (the “Successor Agency”), the successor entity to the former Redevelopment
Agency to the City of Norwalk;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34179(q), commencing on and
after July 1, 2018, the County of Los Angeles, where more than 40 oversight boards were
created by the Dissolution Act, shall have five consolidated oversight boards each
encompassing the five supervisorial districts;

WHEREAS, the Fourth Supervisorial District Consolidated Oversight Board (the
“Oversight Board”) has jurisdiction over the Successor Agency of the former
Redevelopment Agency to the City of Norwalk;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34177(o), the Successor
Agency must prepare a Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule listing the anticipated
payments for enforceable obligations to be made by the Successor Agency during the
fiscal period from July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024 (“ROPS 23-24”) and submit ROPS
23-24 to the 4th District Consolidated Oversight Board for approval;

WHEREAS, the Oversight Board held a regular meeting on January 17, 2023;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34177(l)(2)(C) and Section
34177(o)(1), the Successor Agency must: (i) submit the Oversight Board-approved ROPS
23-24 to the State Department of Finance (the “DOF”), the Office of the State Controller,
and the County Auditor-Controller no later than February 1, 2023, and (ii) post a copy of
the Oversight Board-approved ROPS 23-24 on the Successor Agency’s website;

NOW THEREFORE, THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOURTH SUPERVISORIAL
DISTRICT CONSOLIDATED OVERSIGHT BOARD DOES HEREBY RESOLVE AND
FIND AS FOLLOWS:

Section 1.  The above recitals are true and correct and are a substantive part of this
Resolution.

Resolution No. OB 23-01  Page 1 of 8
 Section 2.  The Oversight Board hereby approves the proposed ROPS 23-24,
substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A. Staff of the Successor Agency is
hereby authorized and directed to: (i) submit a copy of such approved ROPS 23-24 to the
DOF, the Office of the State Controller, and the County Auditor-Controller and (ii) post a
copy of the Oversight Board-approved ROPS 23-24 on the Successor Agency’s Internet
website (being a page on the Internet website of the City of Norwalk).

Section 3.  The members of the Oversight Board and the Staff of the Successor
Agency are hereby authorized and directed, jointly and severally, to do any and all things
which they may deem necessary or advisable to effectuate this Resolution, including
requesting additional review by the DOF and an opportunity to meet and confer on any
disputed items, and any such actions previously taken by such Oversight Board members
or Staff members are hereby ratified and confirmed.

TO:  Honorable Agency Members

FROM:  Jesus M. Gomez, Executive Director

BY:  Jana Stuard, Finance Officer

SUBJECT: PROPOSED ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGETS FOR THE SIX-MONTH
  FISCAL PERIODS JULY 1, 2023 THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2023 AND
  JANUARY 1, 2024 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2024

Background:

Pursuant to 34177(j) of the California Health and Safety Code (HSC), the Successor
Agency is required to prepare a proposed administrative budget for each six-month fiscal
period, which must be submitted to the Oversight Board for approval and the total
administrative budget covering the entire fiscal year cannot exceed $250,000. Each
proposed administrative budget must include all of the following: (1) estimated amounts
for Successor Agency administrative costs for the applicable six-month fiscal period;
(2) proposed sources of payment for the administrative costs; and (3) proposals for
arrangements for administrative and operations services provided by the City of Norwalk
or another entity.

Attached is the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency (Successor
Agency) proposed Administrative Budgets for the six-month fiscal periods from July 1,
2023 through December 31, 2023 and January 1, 2024 through June 30, 2024. Resolution
OB 23-02 approving administrative budgets will be presented before the Los Angeles
County Fourth Supervisorial District Consolidated Oversight Board on January 25, 2023.

The attached administrative budget covering the entire fiscal year 2023/24 complies with
the above listed requirements.

Fiscal Impact: N/A

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Plan 2021 Implementation: N/A

A RESOLUTION OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOURTH SUPERVISORIAL
DISTRICT CONSOLIDATED OVERSIGHT BOARD APPROVING PROPOSED
ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGETS OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY OF THE NORWALK
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY FOR THE SIX-MONTH FISCAL PERIODS FROM JULY
1, 2023 THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2023, AND FROM JANUARY 1, 2024 THROUGH
JUNE 30, 2024 AND TAKING RELATED ACTIONS

WHEREAS, pursuant to ABx 1 26, enacted in June 2011, and as subsequently amended,
including by AB 1484, SB 341, and SB 107 ("Dissolution Act"), the Redevelopment
Agency to the City of Norwalk was dissolved as of February 1, 2012, and the City of
Norwalk elected to serve as the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment
Agency (the “Successor Agency”) to the former Redevelopment Agency to the City of
Norwalk;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34179(q), commencing on and
after July 1, 2018, the County of Los Angeles, where more than 40 oversight boards were
created by the Dissolution Act, shall have five consolidated oversight boards each
encompassing the five supervisorial districts;

WHEREAS, the Fourth Supervisorial District Consolidated Oversight Board (the
“Oversight Board”) has jurisdiction over the Successor Agency of the Former
Redevelopment Agency to the City of Norwalk;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34177(j), the Successor Agency
must prepare a proposed administrative budget for each six-month fiscal period
(commencing each January 1 and July 1) and submit each proposed administrative
budget to the Oversight Board for approval;

WHEREAS, the Successor Agency’s proposed administrative budgets for the six-month
fiscal periods from July 1, 2023 through December 31, 2023 (“Administrative Budget 23-
24A”) and from January 1, 2024 through June 30, 2024 (“Administrative Budget 23-24B”
and, together the “Administrative Budgets”) have been presented to this Oversight Board
for approval;

WHEREAS, the Oversight Board held a regular meeting on January 17, 2023;

NOW THEREFORE, THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOURTH SUPERVISORIAL
DISTRICT CONSOLIDATED OVERSIGHT BOARD DOES HEREBY RESOLVE AND
FIND AS FOLLOWS:

Section 1.  The above recitals are true and correct and are a substantive part of this
Resolution.

Section 2.  The Oversight Board hereby approves Administrative Budgets 23-24A
and 23-24B, substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A.
 Section 3.  The Staff of the Successor Agency are hereby authorized and directed,
jointly and severally, to do any and all things which they may deem necessary or advisable
to effectuate this Resolution and the Administrative Budgets, including making any
adjustment to the proposed Administrative Budgets to make them consistent with the
Successor Agency’s Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule for fiscal year 2023-24
(as such Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule is approved by the State Department
of Finance).
